exposure: previous poor obstetric outcomes (miscarriage, pre-term labour)
previous mode of birth (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 131 women diagnosed with GDM (cases) and 131 age-matched women without GDM (controls), all receiving in-patient care in a tertiary maternity hospital.
finding: BMI >23 kg/m2 and an interpregnancy interval of <2 years were significant risk factors for GDM.
mod_finding: Having had a vaginal birth in previous pregnancies was associated with a diminished risk of developing GDM.
cross-section timing: Pregnancy records from January 2018 to December 2018
